sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Dawley Town on Saturday at 14:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent league defeat. Despite losing their last outing, Sandbach remain top of the table with 31 points from 14 games, having won four consecutive league matches before that setback. The away fixture at Dawley presents an opportunity to reassert their title credentials immediately.
divisionWide: Second-placed AFC Bridgnorth will be keen to capitalize on any stumble from the leaders, having shown solid recent form. The title race remains competitive with Bilston Town just three points back in third and Stafford Town level on 26 points in fourth; Stafford host Telford Town on Saturday at 15:00 in a fixture where they will be heavily favored. Eccleshall, currently fifth, welcome Shawbury United at 15:00 in a battle between mid-table sides. In-form Allscott Heath travel to Wolverhampton Casuals (15:00), both of whom sit in the upper reaches and have shown recent quality. Barnton host Foley Meir (15:00) in a mid-table clash. New Mills face Wednesfield Community (15:00) in a lower-half encounter. Cheadle Heath Nomads host Brereton Social (15:00) in another lower-table affair. Market Drayton Town face Crewe (15:00) as two struggling sides seek points. Widnes Town host Alsager Town (15:00), with both clubs among the division's poorest performers and fighting near the bottom; this fixture is listed twice in the schedule. The fixture between Widnes Town and Alsager Town at The Marine Travel Arena completes the weekend's action at 15:00.
